group_assessment.counts_measured: PubMed esearch 2026-09-14: 'Aldaz CM[au]' 138, 'Aldaz CM[au] AND WWOX' 38; first/corresponding author of the B-cell work 'McBride KM[au]' 53, of which 'McBride KM[au] AND WWOX' 1 - this paper. 'Abba MC[au] AND WWOX' 10, 'Kil H[au] AND WWOX' 10.
group_assessment.weighting: Two capabilities, weighed apart. C. M. Aldaz is a founder of the WWOX field (the 2000 cloning paper is reference 1 here) and the same laboratory built the conditional allele (ref 9) and the WWOX-DEE-relevant neural models (PMID 30290271, 36828035), so it is primary for the gene AND publishes on the disease - both are recorded because they are not the same question and this output touches neither. The B-cell immunology half is NOT this laboratory's native expertise: it is McBride's, whose 53 papers include exactly one on WWOX, and the CSR/translocation assays, AID phosphorylation reagents and Myc/Igh Southern assay are all his established methods (refs 37, 40, 41, 43). So the repair-choice half weighs as competent primary work by a method expert, the tumour-incidence half as a long-latency mouse cohort with blinded histopathology, and the words 'direct role' in the Introduction weigh as the group's interpretation rather than a measurement anyone here made.

field_density.note: The intersection this paper occupies is ONE paper in all of PubMed: 'WWOX AND (class switch recombination OR CSR)' returns 1, and it is this one. WWOX x NHEJ is 7 and WWOX x B-cell 14.
